fetch_policy_note: This manifest is a committed local snapshot of upstream references. DARE Agent Security performs no network fetch of standards at validation time. Canonical references are recorded for attribution and traceability only.

sources.title: OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications
sources.mapping_notes: LLM01 Prompt Injection is the upstream reference for direct and indirect prompt-injection vectors. DARE properties are narrower, deterministically decidable security invariants and are not one-to-one restatements of LLM01.

sources.title: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications for 2026
sources.mapping_notes: ASI01 Agent Goal Hijacking is the agentic-risk parent for the Cycle 013 properties. Goal hijacking is an outcome class; prompt injection is one delivery technique among several that may or may not achieve it.

sources.title: DARE Agent Security Cycle 013 Prompt Injection Validation Contract
sources.mapping_notes: Local project contract binding upstream prompt-injection guidance to deterministic, evidence-backed DARE security invariants with bounded local execution.

taxonomy_distinction.statement: Prompt Injection and Agent Goal Hijacking are related but not equivalent.
taxonomy_distinction.prompt_injection: A delivery technique: untrusted content supplied as data is interpreted as instruction by the model.
taxonomy_distinction.agent_goal_hijack: An outcome: the agent's authorized objective is replaced or subverted, with security-relevant consequence.
non_equivalence_rules: A successful prompt injection does not by itself prove an agent goal hijack.
An observed model-response manipulation without an explicit security-invariant violation is not a FAIL.
An agent goal hijack may occur through techniques other than prompt injection; Cycle 013 covers only the direct and indirect prompt-injection delivery paths.
Cycle 013 maps to ASI01 as a contributing validation technique, never as a claim of full ASI01 coverage.

property_mappings.note: Unchanged Cycle 012 property. Cycle 013 specializes it by source boundary and does not alter its definition or applicability.
Narrower invariant over the user-prompt trust boundary. Contributes evidence toward ASI01; does not assert ASI01 equivalence or completeness.

Narrower invariant over untrusted external content ingested as data. Tool-description poisoning, RAG retrieval poisoning and A2A message injection are deliberately excluded and remain deferred to later cycles.
